definitions.full: H7998. shalal שָׁלָל 75 noun masculine 1Sam 30:16 prey, spoil, plunder, booty ; — absolute ׳שׁ Gen 49:27 +; construct שְׁלַל Judg 5:30 +, suffix שְׁלָלֵךְ Zech 14:1 , שְׁלַלְכֶם Isa 33:4 , etc.; — 1 prey , of Benjamin as wolf Gen 49:27 (poem in J; with חִלֵּק ). 2 booty, spoil of war, of all kinds (often || בַּז ): including garments, gold and silver Josh 7:21 (J), ornaments Judg 8:24-25 , fabrics and women 5:30 a, b, flocks and herds 1Sam 30:20 ; Jer 49:32 ; 2Chr 15:11 , + persons Deut 20:14 (twice in verse), garments, food and drink 2Chr 28:15 , etc. (58 t.; among these) הֶעָרִים שְׁלַל Deut 2:25 ; 2Sam 12:30 ; 1Chr 20:2 and (+ cattle in addition) Deut 3:7 ; Josh 8:27 ; 11:14 (both R D ), compare (also of city) Isa 8:4 ; Deut 13:17 (twice in verse); Zech 14:1 and (+ cattle) Josh 8:2 (R D ), but including person and cattle Deut 20:14 , compare 20:14 ; figurative of entire nation Jer 50:10 ; Ezek 7:21 ; Zech 2:13 ; ׳שׁ in symbolic proper name וגו שָׁלָל ׳מַהֵר Isa 8:1 , 3 , see above p.555:a; ׳שׁ in metaphor of future majesty of י ׳עֶבֶד 53:12 ; לְשׁ נַפְשׁוֺ ׳וְהֳיְתָהאלּוֺ i.e. life shall be spared, Jer 21:9 ; 38:2 ; 39:18 , compare 45:5 . 3 private plunder Isa 10:2 ( שְׁלָלָם אַלְמָנוֺת ), Prov 1:13 and (perhaps in current saying) 16:19 . 4 = gain Prov 31:11 . — שׁ ׳לְצַוִּארֵי Judg 5:30 c is clearly wrong; meaning dubious (see especially GFM); plausible conjectures are שׁ ׳לְצַוָּארַי for my neck as spoil , Reuss Br and others, and שֵׁגָל לְצַוְּארֵי for the neck of the queen Ew Be Kit and others (but שֵׁגָל elsewhere late); Now strike out שָׁלָל and reads לְצַוָּארָיו .
